race.comment: SKIBIDI (8) has built nicely into this campaign, scoring third-up with a strong finishing effort on the Acton. Has more to offer and keeps gun hoop in Loy. Can make it two on the bounce. SHOWTIME MAGGIE (13) bounced back off her disappointing effort at Wagga with a strong finish into second at Goulburn last time. Peaking now but is drawn sticky again so watch for for he charging late. IN THE NIC OF TIME (4) returns and is drawn a dream on the inside. Should land ideally and his recent trial win suggests he will have plenty to offer when they sprint. WINTER STORM (12) has gone under as fav in his two runs back but has since been freshened with 43 days. Keeping safe.
